name: print-social-green-business-solutions-agency-ad-with-greyscale-portrait
title: Grey and green 'Business Solutions Agency' ad with a greyscale man on a laptop and circle shapes
whatItIs: A square ad with a greyscale young man typing on a laptop, large green and black circles behind, a headline 'Business Solutions' with the second word in bright green, letter-spaced 'Agency', a dark circle 'Have an idea or project?' and a green phone pill.
whatItMeans: Modern and focused; greyscale plus one green makes the brand pop.
techniques: Let a single vivid colour carry a greyscale design.
Letter-space small lines around a bold headline.
Put a question in a dark circle as a secondary hook.

vocabulary.definition: A design with one accent colour.
